summary: Verified fix for admin-panel bug where clicking any sidebar menu while on the Booking Details page kept re-opening Booking Details. Tested the exact scenarios in the review request against the built web_panel served at /api/panel.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct: AdminDashboard.jsx now reads the one-shot 'booking' param from react-router useSearchParams and immediately deletes it via setSearchParams(replace:true). Combined with useTabParam.setActive copying from the live searchParams, subsequent menu clicks no longer carry booking=<id> in the URL so the deep-link effect does not re-fire. useEffect depends only on deepBooking so it is a true one-shot.
PanelLayout onNavigate already clears bookingDetailId before setActive, which is additionally defensive — good.
Minor: the useEffect disables exhaustive-deps for setBookingDetailId/searchParams/setSearchParams; functionally fine because the effect is intentionally a one-shot keyed on deepBooking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed scenarios for the bug fix

If web_panel/src changes, rebuild with `cd /app/web_panel && bash build_panel.sh`. verify-otp returns 'token' (not 'access_token'). rca of the issue: Previous bug cause: setActive from useTabParam built the next URLSearchParams by copying the CURRENT searchParams, which still included booking=<id> after a deep link. The old effect was keyed on window.location.search, so every menu click (which only mutated 'tab') kept booking=<id> and re-triggered setBookingDetailId. Fix: AdminDashboard now (a) uses react-router useSearchParams and (b) runs a one-shot useEffect keyed on deepBooking that immediately deletes 'booking' from the URL via setSearchParams(replace:true). All subsequent setActive calls see no booking param, so the booking detail does not re-open on menu clicks.
